test equal skipped
# Check how identical files that are skipped instead of renamed are recorded in the listings
# - Changed on both paths and identical, then changed on Path2 during the sync          file1
# - Changed on both paths and identical, then changed on Path2 during the sync,
#   keeping the same size and modtime                                                   file3 (file3B)
# - New on both paths with --size-only, same size and different content                file10 (file10L, file10R)

test initial bisync
bisync resync

test changed on both paths and identical - file1
touch-glob 2001-01-02 {datadir/} file1.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file1.txt {path1/} file1.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file1.txt {path2/} file1.txt

test changed on Path1 - file2
touch-glob 2001-01-02 {datadir/} file2.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file2.txt {path1/} file2.txt

test bisync with file1 changed on Path2 during the sync
touch-glob 2023-08-26 {datadir/} file7.txt
hook during-sync copy-as {datadir/}file7.txt {path2/} file1.txt
bisync

test bisync after file1 changed on Path2 during the sync
bisync

test changed on both paths and identical - file3
touch-glob 2002-02-02 {datadir/} file3*.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file3.txt {path1/} file3.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file3.txt {path2/} file3.txt

test changed on Path1 - file4
copy-as {datadir/}file2.txt {path1/} file4.txt

test bisync with file3 changed on Path2 during the sync, keeping its size and modtime
hook during-sync delete-file {path2/}file3.txt
hook during-sync copy-as {datadir/}file3B.txt {path2/} file3.txt
bisync

test bisync after file3 changed on Path2 during the sync
bisync

test new on both paths with --size-only, same size and different content - file10 (file10L, file10R)
touch-glob 2001-01-02 {datadir/} file10L.txt
touch-glob 2001-03-04 {datadir/} file10R.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file10L.txt {path1/} file10.txt
copy-as {datadir/}file10R.txt {path2/} file10.txt
bisync size-only

test delete file10 on Path1
delete-file {path1/}file10.txt
bisync size-only
